title: Public-platform exit, substitution, and operating sovereignty
governing_question: What conditions make vendor exit a durable redistribution of operating power rather than a contract change, partial migration, replacement dependency, or formal ownership without practical sovereignty?

systems.case_name: Homes for Ukraine Foundry to Share
systems.incumbent: Palantir Foundry service used for Homes for Ukraine data sharing and case-management support
systems.observed_transition: Official records describe an in-house build, migration of three years of operational data, training, live transition, supplier-contract exit, continuing operation, public ownership of code and data, and reported lower running cost.
systems.open_join: Independent performance, complete residual-custody and deletion proof, long-run staffing durability, affected-person governance, and value recovery.

systems.case_name: NHS product transitions and Federated Data Platform continuity
systems.incumbent: Palantir Foundry and associated NHS data-platform services
systems.replacement: EDGE and other bounded transition products, alongside the continuing Federated Data Platform award
systems.observed_transition: Official procurement records identify transition and exit instruments for bounded products while a larger enterprise platform relationship continues.
systems.open_join: Observed migration completion, data and schema portability, accreditation, user continuity, residual support, enterprise-level replaceability, and post-transition performance.

systems.case_name: NGC2 alternate divisional implementations and common data baseline
systems.incumbent: No single incumbent full stack; a public-customer-directed multi-vendor program with named Anduril, Palantir, Raft, Lockheed Martin, and other component roles
systems.replacement: Alternate divisional implementations and the Army Right to Integrate pathway
systems.observed_transition: The Army preserved multiple prototypes and public integration authority while selecting a common data baseline and differentiated vendor roles.
systems.open_join: Substitution of the common data baseline, interface and accreditation portability, rights to operate without a named component, and observed continuity after component removal.

domain_adapter.name: Public Operating Sovereignty Covenant
public_sovereignty_requirements: The public body can lawfully and practically operate the essential service without the incumbent vendor.
Data, schemas, transformations, workflows, permissions, logs, model and rule versions, documentation, and interface specifications are exportable in usable form.
The public body possesses staff, budget, infrastructure, security, accreditation, incident response, and institutional knowledge sufficient for continuing operation.
Transition preserves service continuity, evidence integrity, affected-person rights, and named operational responsibility.
Residual vendor access, data copies, licenses, support dependencies, cloud dependencies, and intellectual-property limits are inventoried and terminally governed.
A fallback path exists if the replacement fails, and fallback does not silently restore the same dependency.
Affected users and represented people receive notice, continuity protections, evidence access, and standing over material category or purpose changes created by migration.
Post-exit governance specifies who can modify purpose, schema, threshold, permissions, exceptions, and termination.
Public and affected-party value created by migration, learning, reduced cost, or recovered capacity is measured and allocated rather than treated as an unowned residual.

required: independent operation for a defined period
practical ability to replace or modify the replacement

rights_interaction.R1: Users and represented people receive advance notice of material migration effects and service continuity plans.
rights_interaction.R2: Public operators and affected parties can inspect migration records, data lineage, transformations, residual copies, and post-exit errors.
rights_interaction.R3: An independent authority can pause cutover or rollback when continuity, evidence, security, or rights thresholds are not met.
rights_interaction.R4: The authority can compel correction, restore service, delete residual copies, compensate injury, or prohibit an unsafe migration path.
rights_interaction.R5: The public body independently operates, modifies, governs, replaces, and terminates the practical operating layer.
rights_interaction.R6: Affected-party representatives hold binding authority over material purpose, category, threshold, sharing, exception, and successor changes.
rights_interaction.R7: Savings, intellectual property, institutional learning, or other recovered value are retained for public and affected-party benefit under explicit rules.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Timely notice and direct voice about migration, continuity, changed data use, and changed decision rights.
r_level_tests.homes_for_ukraine_observation: Official public guidance and delivery accounts describe the new service and local-authority operation; the present source set does not establish a complete guest and sponsor notice denominator or direct standing over migration design.
r_level_tests.nhs_observation: Formal transition instruments exist, but patient- and frontline-user-specific notice and voice across each bounded transition are not closed.
r_level_tests.ngc2_observation: Soldier and commander feedback is reported, but complete user notice, affected-population voice, and component-removal consequences are not public.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R1 is operationally plausible but incomplete across the exit domain.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Inspection of data, schema, workflow, configuration, migration, deletion, incident, and performance evidence.
r_level_tests.homes_for_ukraine_observation: The public delivery account identifies the migration and continuing service, but an independent migration audit, residual data inventory, deletion certificates, and error denominator remain open.
r_level_tests.nhs_observation: Procurement notices identify transition obligations without closing complete technical portability, user access, or post-transition audit records.
r_level_tests.ngc2_observation: Public records identify integration and common-baseline roles without supplying interface-control, lineage, accreditation, or component-removal evidence.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R2 requires technical and custody records beyond formal transition language.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Independent authority can pause cutover or require rollback before avoidable service, evidence, or rights failure.
r_level_tests.homes_for_ukraine_observation: Phased quality assurance and transition management are reported; no independently governed stop or rollback record is established.
r_level_tests.nhs_observation: Exit and transition contracts may contain acceptance gates, but the operative pause, rollback, and burden-allocation records are not public.
r_level_tests.ngc2_observation: The Army retains program, integration, and component-selection authority; observed component-level abort and rollback records remain open.
r_level_tests.domain_result: Public customer authority exists, but the independent and rights-protecting R3 mechanism is not yet established.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Binding correction, restoration, deletion, compensation, or prohibition when migration causes injury or leaves residual custody.
r_level_tests.homes_for_ukraine_observation: No complete residual deletion, migration-error remedy, compensation, or person-level correction ledger is present.
r_level_tests.nhs_observation: Formal exit rights do not establish completed deletion, restoration, compensation, or prohibition in a failed transition.
r_level_tests.ngc2_observation: Public integration authority does not establish person-level remedy or complete evidence correction following a component failure.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R4 is the largest remedial deficit in the public-exit domain.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Durable public substitution and independent operating capacity.
r_level_tests.homes_for_ukraine_observation: An in-house replacement, multi-year data migration, user training, supplier exit, and continuing operation are officially reported.
r_level_tests.nhs_observation: Bounded product transitions are documented while a larger enterprise platform relationship continues; product-level movement cannot establish enterprise exit.
r_level_tests.ngc2_observation: Alternate implementations and public integration authority establish plurality but not completed substitution of the common baseline or every critical component.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R5 has one bounded positive control and two controls against universalizing it.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Represented-party authority over post-exit purpose, categories, thresholds, sharing, exceptions, and successor selection.
r_level_tests.homes_for_ukraine_observation: User research and feedback do not establish binding guest, sponsor, or local-authority co-governance over the system constitution.
r_level_tests.nhs_observation: Formal public governance and consultation do not establish patient co-governance over platform purpose and successor selection.
r_level_tests.ngc2_observation: Commander and Soldier feedback does not establish represented-population co-governance over the mission or technical constitution.
r_level_tests.domain_result: Public ownership and operating capacity do not by themselves produce R6.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Public and affected parties recover savings, IP, learning, ownership, or other value created through exit.
r_level_tests.homes_for_ukraine_observation: Official accounts report public ownership and reduced running cost, but the long-run value ledger and affected-party distribution are not independently reconciled.
r_level_tests.nhs_observation: Transition obligations and public data rights do not establish realized value recovery or affected-party distribution.
r_level_tests.ngc2_observation: Right to Integrate and public mission authority do not establish public residual rights in vendor IP, learning, or private valuation.
r_level_tests.domain_result: R7 remains open in the exit domain.

exit_fault_lines.name: formal ownership versus operating capacity
exit_fault_lines.observation: A public body may own data or contract rights while lacking the people, interfaces, security, models, documentation, and authority required to operate independently.
exit_fault_lines.required_control: Test every essential capability and named operational responsibility after vendor withdrawal.

exit_fault_lines.name: product exit versus enterprise exit
exit_fault_lines.observation: A bounded dashboard, workflow, or service may migrate while the institution remains dependent on a larger platform or common layer.
exit_fault_lines.required_control: Map the entire dependency tree and state the exact exited function.

exit_fault_lines.name: new vendor versus new dependency
exit_fault_lines.observation: Substitution can move custody and control to another private layer without increasing public sovereignty.
exit_fault_lines.required_control: Compare rights, interfaces, custody, portability, staffing, and exit conditions before and after.

exit_fault_lines.name: transition completion versus residual custody
exit_fault_lines.observation: Operational cutover does not prove deletion, license termination, support cessation, or removal of historical copies and derived outputs.
exit_fault_lines.required_control: Require residual-custody inventory, deletion or retention authority, and independent verification.

exit_fault_lines.name: public capacity versus democratic governance
exit_fault_lines.observation: A public institution may regain technical control while affected people remain outside purpose, category, threshold, and use decisions.
exit_fault_lines.required_control: Join R5 to an explicit R6 constitution rather than treating public ownership as self-legitimating.

exit_fault_lines.name: reported savings versus full value ledger
exit_fault_lines.observation: Lower running cost can omit migration expense, hidden cloud or supplier dependencies, error cost, staff burden, and distribution of recovered capacity.
exit_fault_lines.required_control: Reconcile total cost, performance, public IP, institutional learning, and affected-party value.

exit_fault_lines.name: plurality versus substitutability
exit_fault_lines.observation: Multiple vendors or prototypes can coexist while one common data, identity, interface, accreditation, or hosting layer remains indispensable.
exit_fault_lines.required_control: Operate a component-removal or alternative-baseline counterfactual and measure continuity.

exit_fault_lines.name: successful cutover versus durable sovereignty
exit_fault_lines.observation: A transition can succeed once but fail after staff turnover, emergency pressure, administration change, platform updates, or successor procurement.
exit_fault_lines.required_control: Test the replacement over time, under incident load, and through one further modification or vendor change.

cross_system_controls.claim: Homes for Ukraine Share demonstrates one bounded case of public-platform substitution and continuing public operation.
cross_system_controls.limit: The evidence is principally an official delivery account and does not close residual deletion, independent performance, R6, R7, or universal substitutability.

cross_system_controls.claim: One successful public exit proves Palantir or any enterprise platform is generally replaceable.
cross_system_controls.limit: Complexity, accreditation, interfaces, mission criticality, staffing, and residual rights vary by deployment.

cross_system_controls.claim: NHS transition and exit contracts prove completed enterprise-level migration away from Palantir.
cross_system_controls.limit: Bounded transition instruments coexist with a larger continuing FDP award.

cross_system_controls.claim: NGC2's alternate implementations prove every critical component is substitutable.
cross_system_controls.limit: The common data baseline, interfaces, accreditation, and integration knowledge may remain concentrated.

cross_system_controls.claim: Public ownership of data or code proves R5.
cross_system_controls.limit: R5 requires observed independent operation, continuity, modification, governance, and repeatable exit.

cross_system_controls.claim: R5 public operating capacity supplies R6 co-governance and R7 value recovery.
cross_system_controls.limit: Affected-party authority and value allocation require separate constitutions and observed records.

propositions.claim: Homes for Ukraine Share is a bounded observed R5 positive control.
counterevidence: the evidence is principally an official delivery account
complete residual deletion and independent cost and performance audit are absent
R6 and complete R7 are not established
propositions.falsifier: The replacement was not independently operated, continuity materially failed, or essential functions remained controlled by the incumbent.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep the result bounded to the named service until the complete operating-sovereignty matrix is source-bounded.

propositions.claim: One bounded Homes for Ukraine exit proves universal Palantir substitutability.
counterevidence: the case provides a real comparator against claims of absolute impossibility
public internal capacity can replace at least one bounded service
propositions.falsifier: Matched enterprise deployments repeatedly achieve equivalent exits with preserved continuity and rights.
propositions.stopping_rule: Require deployment-specific portability, accreditation, staffing, custody, and post-exit performance.

propositions.claim: NHS transition and exit instruments establish completed enterprise-level Palantir exit.
counterevidence: the contracts establish real transition obligations
propositions.falsifier: Completion records show the enterprise operating layer was fully migrated and independently operated.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not convert transition language or one product movement into enterprise exit.

propositions.claim: NGC2 preserves meaningful counterfactual plurality while leaving common-layer substitutability unresolved.
counterevidence: different implementations may not have equivalent technical scope
the common data baseline can concentrate dependency
final acceptance and component-removal tests remain open
propositions.falsifier: The alternate implementation was nominal or all meaningful integration depended on one unavoidable private layer.
propositions.stopping_rule: Separate program plurality from the substitutability of each critical component.

propositions.claim: Formal public ownership of data or code is sufficient for R5.
counterevidence: ownership can strengthen bargaining and transition
source and data rights are necessary parts of exit
propositions.falsifier: The public body repeatedly operates, modifies, secures, accredits, and replaces the system using only the formal ownership right.
propositions.stopping_rule: Require observed capability and continuity, not title alone.

propositions.claim: Public operating sovereignty automatically creates represented-party co-governance.
counterevidence: public institutions may be more legally accountable than private vendors
user research and public oversight can improve the service
propositions.falsifier: Affected people hold binding authority over purpose, category, threshold, sharing, exception, and termination in the replacement system.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep public operation and affected-party sovereignty separate.

propositions.claim: Reported public savings and ownership close R7 value recovery.
counterevidence: lower running cost and public code ownership are plausible public value gains
propositions.falsifier: A complete ledger shows no net public gain or the recovered value is not retained for public and affected-party benefit.
propositions.stopping_rule: Reconcile full cost, performance, IP, learning, staff capacity, and distribution before assigning R7.

propositions.claim: APC-EXIT-01 is ready for pilot specification in a bounded public-platform migration.
counterevidence: one positive control and two incomplete controls do not prove the adapter works
independent stop, complete remedy, R6, and R7 remain weak or absent
propositions.falsifier: The adapter cannot be implemented without unacceptable service risk, hidden dependency, or rights regression.
propositions.stopping_rule: Require one observed migration operated under the adapter and independently audited through the durability window.

current_result.strongest_result: One bounded public institution reportedly built, migrated, trained, exited, and continued operating a replacement service.
current_result.largest_limit: No current system closes the full matrix of independent audit, residual deletion, long-run durability, R6 co-governance, and R7 distribution.
